plainLanguage: Section 78 — Dispersion of rioters after proclamation — ni sehemu ya mfumo wa Chapter IX unaohusu unlawful assemblies, riots na public tranquility.
meaning: After the statutory proclamation conditions, it authorises dispersal or apprehension and permits only such force as is reasonably necessary to overcome resistance.
keyPoints: A reasonable time after proclamation is required, unless proclamation was prevented by force.
Twelve or more persons must continue riotously assembled.
Force is limited by the statutory reasonably-necessary standard.

history.summary: Section 78 appears in Chapter IX of The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Text verified against the R.E. 2022 government-hosted Penal Code.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Each statutory threshold and sequence should be proved from evidence.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Requirements such as reasonable time, authorised actors and reasonable necessity materially limit the provision's operation.

debateQuestion: Je, statutory conditions zote za section 78 zimetimizwa kwa facts husika?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
